name: Uranus
defines: Where you break from convention. Uranus spends about seven years in each sign, so this describes what your whole age group was restless about — the house it falls in shows where it lands in your own life.

aries.definition: A generation that broke with the past by acting first and asking permission never. The change was in who was allowed to start something.
aries.showsUp: You are impatient with process, drawn to doing it yourself, and instinctively suspicious of anyone who says a thing cannot be begun.

taurus.definition: A generation that upended money, land and what counts as value. The change was in the material foundations everyone had assumed were fixed.
taurus.showsUp: You hold unorthodox views about ownership and security, you resist change until you choose it, and then you change something structural.

gemini.definition: A generation that transformed how information moves. The change was in communication itself — its speed, its reach and who controlled it.
gemini.showsUp: You are quick to adopt new ways of talking to people, restless with received wisdom, and drawn to ideas for their novelty.

cancer.definition: A generation that rewrote the family. The change was in what a home is and who is allowed to make one.
cancer.showsUp: Your domestic life is unconventional in some way, you are emotionally independent, and you resist being told what a family should look like.

leo.definition: A generation that reinvented self-expression and celebrity. The change was in who got to be seen and on whose terms.
leo.showsUp: You insist on being yourself conspicuously, you are drawn to unusual creative work, and you refuse to perform a role you did not choose.

virgo.definition: A generation that overhauled work, health and craft. The change was in the systems and methods underneath everything.
virgo.showsUp: You question standard procedure as a matter of course, you find unorthodox solutions to practical problems, and you have your own way of doing everything.

libra.definition: A generation that redefined partnership and fairness. The change was in relationships, equality and the law that governs them.
libra.showsUp: You hold liberal views about how people should pair up and how justice should work, and you need independence inside your closest relationships.

scorpio.definition: A generation that dragged the hidden into the open. The change was in power, sexuality and money — the things nobody discussed.
scorpio.showsUp: You are unshockable, drawn to what other people flinch from, and impatient with secrecy dressed up as decorum.

sagittarius.definition: A generation that broke open belief and borders. The change was in religion, education and how far people could travel.
sagittarius.showsUp: You are restless with dogma, drawn to unfamiliar cultures, and you would rather work out your own philosophy than inherit one.

capricorn.definition: A generation that took apart institutions. The change was in authority, government and the structures everyone had trusted.
capricorn.showsUp: You are sceptical of institutions while working effectively inside them, and you reform things from the position rather than from outside it.

aquarius.definition: A generation defined by technology and collective ideals. Uranus rules this sign, so the break with the past was the whole point.
aquarius.showsUp: You take radical change as normal, you think in terms of systems and networks, and you are genuinely unbothered by being different.

pisces.definition: A generation that dissolved boundaries — spiritual, artistic and psychological. The change was in the imagination.
pisces.showsUp: You are drawn to unorthodox spirituality and art, you sense shifts before they are visible, and you have little respect for arbitrary limits.
